fusions.name: Cut From the Herd
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ring of Warm Bodies
fusions.desc: The pack closes in around you, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Lie Close
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Weathered Together
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
